title: profile not coming back 100%
body:
I upgraded from dev-c to dev-d and noticed a problem

Automation sets the profile to the desired value and time, after this time the profile does not set itself to 100%
![Screenshot_20241104_103344_AAPSClient](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8cdc7818-52e2-4954-901b-e303ea7950d2)
![Screenshot_20241104_111457_TeamViewer](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e974457a-a6be-485a-912a-fcf67c8cdd2f)

comments.body: Have seen this once (after -45 mins, temp profile stil running) , unable to reproduce. 🧐
the only possible reason I see is when pump is not reachable. Otherwise profile is switched within 5 min

I ran tests, set the profile to 90% for 5 minutes and after 15 minutes it was -10 and nothing happened, I went back to the older version of Dev-c and the profiles change as they should, when I was building the application the servers were probably overloaded because it was laborious, today I made a new apk, installed it on my phone and set up a virtual pump, for now everything is fine, I will test for 2 days and update the master and write if everything is fine

the connection to the pump was definitely there, since it was serving smb, as you can see in the screenshots, the profile was set to 130% at 8:40. after that time it was serving smb, I turned off the profile manually at 10:36
![Screenshot_20241104_201931_TeamViewer](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/910344fc-8f1b-447a-9096-81bda00ec508)

if you have logs we can check
I changed the version to dev - c, I don't know if the logs were saved, and I didn't download them then.
create new issue with logs if it happen again
